titulo_es: Reduce a sequence with the infinite past

bloques.titulo: Selection of the auxiliary in the infinitive
texto: **Con avere**: transient verbs («Dopo aver esaminato gli atti, il giudice emanò la sentenza») and most intransitions.
**Con essere**: verbs of movement, change of state and reflexive, with mandatory agreement of the participle («Dopo essere arrivata alla stazione, Chiara chiamò un taxi»).

The clytic pronouns are enclytically joined at the end of the apocopate monosyllic auxiliary (**dopo averlo visto**, **dopo essersene andato**) or to the full infinitive: «Dopo avergli parlato, mi sono tranquillizzato».

frases.it: Ha consegnato la tesi finale al professore?
frases.es: ¿Ha entregado la tesis final al profesor?
frases.en: Have you given the final thesis to the teacher?

frases.it: Sì, dopo aver revisionato tutti i capitoli, ho stampato il testo definitivo.
frases.es: Sí, tras haber revisado todos los capítulos, imprimí el texto definitivo.
frases.en: Yes, after having reviewed all the chapters, I printed the final text.

frases.it: E dopo essersi laureata intende proseguire con il dottorato?
frases.es: ¿Y tras haberse graduado piensa continuar con el doctorado?
frases.en: And after graduating, do you plan to continue with the doctorate?

frases.it: Certamente, dopo aver chiarito la borsa di studio presenterò la candidatura.
frases.es: Por supuesto, tras haber aclarado la beca de estudios presentaré la candidatura.
frases.en: Of course, after I have clarified the study scholarship, I will present the nomination.

bloques.pregunta: What is the syntactic requirement for using «dopo aver fatto» correctly?

opciones.texto: That the subject of the subordinate coincides with the subject of the main prayer
opciones.explicacion: «Dopo aver revisionato i dati, la ricercatrice stampò il saggio».

opciones.texto: The main sentence must be formulated in a subjunctive manner
opciones.explicacion: It usually works with indicative, conditional or mandatory.

opciones.texto: Que el verbo subordinado sea exclusivamente intransitivo de movimiento
opciones.explicacion: It is used primarily with transient verbs with the «avere» auxiliary.

bloques.frase: Dopo ___ arrivata a Firenze, Marta ha telefonato subito ai colleghi.

opciones.explicacion: The verb «arrivare» requires the «essere» Auxiliary with feminine singular-compliant.
Wrong assistant incompatible with inaccusative verbs of movement.
Not apoculated form and wrong auxiliary for «arrivare».

bloques.frase: Dopo avergli consegnato il fascicolo, l'avvocato lasciò lo studio.

opciones.texto: The lawyer delivered the file to the addressee and then left the office.
opciones.explicacion: «Dopo avergli consegnato» marks previously with indirect clite clite.

opciones.texto: The lawyer forgot the file on the table before he went to court.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the express act of delivery.

opciones.texto: The client promised to send the documentation by mail the next day.
opciones.explicacion: Alters the subject and moves the action to the future.

bloques.pregunta: How are the clytic pronouns placed with the infinite past in «dopo averlo visto»?

opciones.texto: Se adhieren enclíticamente al final del auxiliar infinitivo apocopado
opciones.explicacion: «Aver» loses the -e and receives the «-lo» pronoun.

opciones.texto: Se sitúan obligatoriamente separados entre «dopo» y el auxiliar
opciones.explicacion: Agrammatical structure in the Italian language.

opciones.texto: They are placed at the end of the conjugated past participle
opciones.explicacion: The clytic does not bind to the participle when there is an infinitive auxiliary.

bloques.frase: Dopo essersi ___ all'università, Luca ha iniziato subito a lavorare in banca.

opciones.explicacion: Participio that matches masculine singular with the Luca subject after «essersi».
Infinitive incompatible after the reflective auxiliary «essersi».
Plural form that does not match the singular subject.

bloques.frase: Dopo aver chiarito la situazione partì
bloques.traduccion: After having clarified the situation, he left
bloques.explicacion: Order the phrase with a composite infinitive.

bloques.pregunta: What is the right form for «after they left»?

opciones.explicacion: Ne- clíticos are adapted and plural participle concorded with parrot.
Wrong selection of auxiliary and clit.
Don't worry about the plural concordance of the participle.

intro: The «dopo aver / dopo essere + participio» structure allows for the elegant synthesis of two temporary sentences in a single reduced construction of infinitive compound. To use it impeccable in level B2, the subject of the implied infinitive must be strictly in line with the subject of the main prayer.
